reviews.comment:
Opcion ideal si estas en viaje para cargar combustible. Paro ahi desde hace mas de 30 años! Si pasas por ahí seguro el calor te dejara sin aliento. La nafta es buena , ser un ACA, lo que no es bueno es el shop. Caro y poca variedad. Baños limpios, dato importante!!!

(Translated by Google)
Ideal option if you're traveling and need to refuel. I've been stopping there for over 30 years! If you pass by, the heat will definitely leave you breathless. The gas is good, being an ACA (Automobile Club of Argentina), but the convenience store isn't great. Expensive and not much variety. Clean restrooms, though—important!
